title.narrative: Accelerated response to HIV through effective prevention, treatment, care and support interventions, with surveillance in high risks areas - Pakistan (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Pakistan, HIV, Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination of Pakistan (NACP)This program has the following goals: Enhanced HIV prevention services among key and general populations their partners and reduce risk behaviours. Increased testing coverage among key populations and their partners. Increased access to treatment, care and support. Strengthened Integrated and Resilient Systems for Health (RSSH). Environment is enabled for an effective and sustainable AIDS response. The objectives of this program are: To increase coverage of the prevention services for MSM to 27% by 2026 from the 23% at 2023 baseline. To increase coverage of the prevention services for FSW to 48% by 2026 from the 33% at 2023 baseline. To ensure provision of prevention services to atleast 80% of TG by 2026. To increase coverage of the prevention services for PWIDs to 54% by 2026 from the 38% at 2023 baseline. To accelerate scale-up of community-based HTS for MSM key populations to 22% by 2026 from 10% at 2023 baseline. To accelerate scale-up of community-based HTS for SW key populations to 39% by 2026 from 10% at 2023 baseline. To accelerate scale-up of community-based HTS forTG key populations to 66% by 2026 from 36% at 2023 baseline. To accelerate scale-up of community-based HTS for PUD key populations to 24% by 2026 from 14% at 2022 baseline. To enhance coverage of the treatment services for PLHIV by 30% from base line of 15% (2023) to 45% by end of 2026. To improve the Viral Load testing of people living with HIV and on ART from the baseline of 40% (2023) to 60% by the end of 2026 through reconfiguration of viral load testing mechanism.
